findings.current: This is a clash between at least Supreme Peak masters.
findings.defect: The source first says the narrator can feel a wave of qi all the way here despite the considerable distance, then identifies the clash as involving at least Supreme Peak masters. The translation omits that sensory observation.
findings.rationale: The omitted observation establishes what the narrator sensed before drawing his conclusion; the accepted baseline also preserves it.
findings.replacement: Despite the considerable distance, I could feel the wave of qi all the way here. This was a clash between at least Supreme Peak masters.

summary: The translation is largely faithful, but it omits two source details: the crowd’s differences and the narrator’s perception of the distant qi wave.
